description: Canonical field registry for identity_claim — a piece of identity evidence. Claims are normalized values extracted from source identities: email, phone, name, external_customer_id, app_user_id, anonymous_id, device_id, installation_id, wallet_address, account_id, agent_id, runtime_id, address, company, domain, consent_grant, auth_subject. Raw records are immutable — identity resolution may change but claims do not.

blocks.name: identity_claim
blocks.description: A piece of identity evidence extracted from a source identity.

fields.name: source_record_id
fields.description: Stable source-row identifier preserving claim provenance.

fields.name: import_id
fields.description: Owning import for connector or CSV evidence.

fields.name: import_commit_id
fields.description: Exact commit that materialized this imported identity evidence.

fields.name: normalized_value
fields.description: In privacy-safe CSV and SDK ingestion, email and phone are tenant/type-scoped HMAC-SHA256 digests of the shared normalized form; other claim types store their normalized value.

fields.name: raw_value
fields.description: Original value for claim paths that retain raw non-email/non-phone values; privacy-safe email and phone ingestion omits this field.

fields.name: confidence_hint
fields.description: Optional confidence hint (0.0-1.0) from the source.

fields.name: occurred_at
fields.description: When this claim was observed in the source system.
